prompts.name: basic
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: small enemy portrait icon for an existing cartoon 3D tower-defense game's HUD. First input is the exact enemy identity reference; second input is the game's established icon style reference. Create ONE polished icon of the enemy described below. Chunky faceted 3D cartoon illustration, rich clean color blocks, thick dark outer silhouette outline, restrained light shading and small highlights, visually matching the second reference. Front or very slight three-quarter portrait, main silhouette occupies 85% of a square with generous clear padding, readable when reduced to 40px. Keep the distinctive sleepy protruding white eyes and horizontal pupils. Brighten the dull source render naturally. Genuine transparent background, no floor, no drop-shadow plane, no circular badge, no frame, no words, no numbers, no extra characters, no particles. Subject: A squat bright pink bean-shaped blob, two bulging white eyes with sleepy horizontal black pupils and dark pink tear marks. Keep the exact simple recognizable silhouette.
